responsibility: Declares the token model, keyword and pragma enums, and the `Lex` scanner interface used by the Go parser to read source text with location tracking, semicolon insertion, literal decoding, directive capture, and identifier/export-status queries. This header defines the frontend’s lexical vocabulary and the side channels through which parsing receives pragmas, linkname directives, and embed patterns.
same_name_distinction: Defines the lexical interface used by the parser: token/keyword/pragma enums, the `Token` representation, `Lex` class API, and directive side-channel data structures. Unlike `lex.cc`, it declares the scanner’s vocabulary and public surface without embedding the scanning logic or large Unicode tables.
